rheumatology.unit_name: Servicio de Reumatología, Hospital San Juan de Dios
rheumatology.evidence_quote: "SERVICIO DE REUMATOLOGÍA". UBO confirma que el Hospital San Juan de Dios tiene "un convenio ya suscrito con la Universidad".

hiring.positions_note: none open today. The official UBO employment portal displayed “Últimos empleos publicados” but no job listings when checked on 3 September 2026.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No open post was listed, so the portal published no requirements concerning foreign degrees, revalidación, or Chilean nationality.

international.notes: UBO has an international office and virtual/in-person mobility arrangements. I found no official evidence that a Medicina course itself is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: UBO created its Faculty of Medical Sciences in the first semester of 2020; its Medicine degree began in 2021. The faculty is based at Rondizzoni II in Santiago.
Medicine is a 14-semester (seven-year) programme leading to the Licentiate in Medicine and Médico Cirujano title. Its current dean is Jorge Rodríguez Díaz.

The programme states that its final two years comprise four semesters of clinical internships, including internal medicine, emergency medicine, surgery/trauma, paediatrics, obstetrics and primary care.

UBO has a signed agreement with Hospital San Juan de Dios. That hospital’s official service directory lists a Rheumatology Service, which may make it a useful clinical-network contact; UBO itself did not evidence a rheumatology specialty programme.
